title: Machine learning prognosis model based on patient-reported outcomes for chronic heart failure patients after discharge
summary: Prospective CHF-PRO models predict two-year outcomes and compare six algorithms with validation data; discrimination is modest for some endpoints and should not be represented as strong clinical decision accuracy.
ai_technology: Six machine-learning algorithms model two-year heart-failure outcomes; XGBoost provides the reported predictions.
organization: Department of Cardiology, the 1st Hospital of Shanxi Medical University, 85 South Jiefang Road, Taiyuan, Shanxi Province, 030001, China.

evidence.tested: 941 prospective-cohort patients, 2-year mortality/HF hospitalization/MACE; six ML approaches, 10-fold tuning, separate Shanxi Cardiovascular Hospital validation; XGBoost AUC .754/.718/.670.
